```
The interactive re-prompt for the implement-rigor typed choice (BEH-12: 'Blank or any other input is re-prompted interactively') is a retry-until-valid loop with no iteration cap and no cap-trip verdict. The spec states no maximum number of re-prompts, no verdict at exhaustion, and no stdin-EOF behaviour, so a TTY-attached but scripted session can loop indefinitely. Recommendation: state a maximum number of re-prompts and the verdict at exhaustion (for example exit 1 with INVALID_IMPLEMENT_RIGOR, nothing written), and state that input closing (EOF) terminates the loop with the same verdict.
```

**Reviewer:** termination-reviewer

```
BEH-15's unattended branch is defined by dispatch route ('/adev:implement dispatched as a /adev:build or /adev:work step'), not by runtime condition, and the spec gives no detection rule. A /adev:implement run with no operator present (headless claude -p, a scheduled job, an agent with no supervising session) falls to the interactive verdict ('escalates to the operator'), which has no operator to receive it. Recommendation: define the unattended case by the runtime condition (no operator present, however invoked), state how the skill detects it, and apply the BEH-15 unattended verdict to every run that matches; keep the build/work dispatch case as one example.
```
